entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I'm calling about an order I received a while back. I need to make a return.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF88675309.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order pulled up here for the ProFit Jersey. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. I ordered the wrong size for the jersey. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's just too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to exchange it.
I see. Getting the perfect fit is definitely important. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. I see the order was delivered 43 days ago. One moment...
Okay, great news. The ProFit Jersey is a standard item and falls under our 90-day return policy, so you're well within the timeframe. I can process that return for you right now.

Excellent, thank you. Now, I see I'm listed as a VIP member in my account. Given the inconvenience of having to process this, would it be possible to get a small discount code for when I re-purchase the correct size?

That's a fair question. I do see your VIP status here, and we really appreciate your loyalty. While our system doesn't allow me to generate a separate discount code for a return, I can offer you a $15 goodwill credit on your VeloFit account. You can apply that directly to your exchange or any future purchase. How does that sound?
A $15 credit would be perfect. That works for me. Thank you for looking into that, Charlie.

You're very welcome, Alex. I've gone ahead and initiated the return and also applied that credit to your account. I just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Please package the jersey, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
Sounds great. I appreciate the easy process.
It was my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
